title: Research consolidation: bind PR116 evidence-only head to tested sources (no new kappa)
body:
This independent historical source/evidence contribution now integrates canonical main `38746ad3f6ffebcc0275e286b1dbb733d7c696dd` without undoing PR116's completed review and closure. A scoped `PARENT-EVIDENCE.json` input and the ledger generator append one evidence pointer. All **2,397 records** retain their prior dispositions, heads, attribution, review-completion fields and closure receipts. PR116 remains incorporated/CLOSED; PR1007 is not promoted to reviewed or incorporated. No new kappa or selected-result change.

The unchanged offline standard-library capsule decodes 208 anchored Git objects and compares both complete historical trees (1,559 to 1,560 paths). Exactly three evidence/status paths change, while all 41 scientific/dependency objects retain identical Git IDs and modes. It binds 42 saved checks and the actual synthetic merge checked out by three focused Python jobs. Those are recovered historical executions, not a fresh supplier replay.

Scientific base: `8bddbee377e2f3ce1f1247196c4b290d55767d20`; PR116 scientific head `97750ec74fc714638c0aa4f31aaa880e56cb8b4d`, evidence head `295a48a3b966428896057a98c6b4834c0b4b7416`, historical focused checkout `0db8566d07ae1fd7765d5d98fbb32ad22775ed32`. Current author head: `4687c59630991fdf4e57fab16ccacc92713a4d44`.

```sh
python3.12 -I -O -B research/pr116-evidence-reconciliation/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/pr116-evidence-reconciliation/test_package.py
python3.12 -I -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_pr116_ledger_evidence.py
python3.12 -B scripts/reconcile_pr_queue.py
make selected-record-check
```

Fresh exact-head CPython 3.12.12 replay, all 28 package tests, two ledger regressions, byte-stable regeneration, every-record comparison, preserved scientific-byte comparison, selected-record integrity and whitespace pass. Separate source/generator audit agrees. A final clean synthetic merge against newer main `2b4c46fbb19b2df3685b751965877fa7c7fa34af` also preserves its complete current records and regenerates both ledgers byte-identically; synchronization does not discard later decisions. Hosted CI is separate and recorded in the follow-up comment.

The original capsule, result, producer, checker and package tests remain unchanged. [VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4687c59630991fdf4e57fab16ccacc92713a4d44/research/pr116-evidence-reconciliation/VALIDATION.md) distinguishes this later integration from earlier pinned broader-check failures. No current whole-repository pass is inferred from those historical results.

The author's standalone 3,733-second local archive was not recovered; its receipt alone remains. Full `make verify`, fresh supplier replay, Lean compilation and theorem admission are outside scope. The later [PR116 review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/67b122d33d6c599a49f65d50afa2f3fe8d790d02/docs/research/community-reconciliation92-review.md) remains authoritative. This addresses [the integration request](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1007#issuecomment-6161276240).

Credit Rohan Arun's PR116 and receipt, Douglas Colkitt's earlier observation, icekylinx, eumemic, Avi Eisenberg, Rohan Gupta, Swapnil Jain and inherited lineage. Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review claimed. Apache-2.0; frozen sources and `upstream/` preserved.
